description:
Create a hosted Stripe Checkout session ($10-$500 USD, zero crypto) to fund a new or existing master spend key. Use this to provision or top up an account; do not use to check balances (x402_get_account) or mint subagent keys (x402_issue_delegate_key).
Parameters: omit spend_key/header to create a new master account (returns one-time spend_key), or pass an existing master key to top up (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: uncharged until paid (~4s credit); 31-min expiry; retries open new sessions. Max 3 open unpaid/account (HTTP 409 checkout_already_open returns error only, no prior URLs); 30/min global; HTTP 403 for delegates.

amount_cents.description: Prepaid Stripe credit pack size in USD cents: 1000 ($10), 2500 ($25), 10000 ($100), 25000 ($250), or 50000 ($500).

return_surface.description: Web console surface to redirect the operator to after Stripe Checkout finishes: "x402" (default, quantumatlas.xyz/x402/), "developers", or "app".

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_create_checkout

account_id.description: Master account identifier that will receive the credit pack.

amount_usd.description: Formatted USD amount of the selected credit pack.

checkout_url.description: Hosted Stripe Checkout URL for the human operator to complete payment.

ok.description: True when the Stripe Checkout session was created.

spend_key.description: Newly generated master sbk_* key (returned only when creating a brand-new account).

title: Create Stripe Credit Checkout
